title: incident-bot: improve SLO toolkit auto-diagnostics and on-call summary heuristics
author: Ethan Morales
release_notes: Improves SLO toolkit auto-diagnostics ranking and expands incident-bot on-call summary heuristics; no user-facing API changes; rollout by feature flag.
description: Context: Oncall teams have asked for clearer, higher-signal automated diagnostics and condensed runbook links in incident-bot summaries for SLO violations. Motivation: reduce mean time to remediation by surfacing prioritized diagnostics and actionable runbook links in the first on-call summary and reduce noise from low-confidence autosuggestions. This PR implements heuristics and helper utilities in the SLO toolkit to score and rank diagnostics, adds a compact summary template for on-call messages, and wires the new utilities into incident-bot generation logic. Design summary: 1) Introduce slokit.autodiag.ScoreComponents to weight telemetry signals (error rate delta, recent deploys, host-level saturation, anomaly score) and produce a single diagnostic confidence score. 2) Add slokit.ranking.TopKFilter to reduce suggestions to the highest-confidence items and de-duplicate runbook links. 3) Provide a compact oncall-summary template that collapses low-confidence items behind a "see details" link and surfaces top-3 actions inline. 4) Add a feature flag incident_bot.enable_compact_autodiags controlled by org config for gradual rollout. Rollout plan: feature-flagged rollout to canary orgs for 48 hours, followed by staged ramp to 25% then 100% with a kill-switch. Testing: unit tests for scoring and dedupe logic, end-to-end test using the incident-bot harness that validates compact summary rendering, and smoke tests validating no additional rate to downstream services. Checklist: - [x] Add scoring primitives and docs - [x] Integrate TopK ranking into incident generation path - [x] Add compact summary template and i18n keys - [x] Add unit + integration tests - [x] Add feature flag gating and telemetry metrics (autodiag.count, autodiag.show_rate) - [x] Update runbook linking logic to prefer canonical runbooks Notes: kept the scoring weights conservative to avoid surfacing noisy autosuggestions; follow-up planned to expose weights via the Console tuning UI.
